required_event_semantics.draft_pull_request: every top-level full-CI job is server-side skipped before runner allocation
required_event_semantics.ready_pull_request: the pre-existing job-level if condition, if any, remains authoritative
required_event_semantics.push: the pre-existing job-level if condition, if any, remains authoritative
required_event_semantics.schedule: the pre-existing job-level if condition, if any, remains authoritative
required_event_semantics.workflow_dispatch: the pre-existing job-level if condition, if any, remains authoritative

permitted_transformations: job with no job-level if: insert exactly one scalar admission predicate
job with scalar job-level if: replace it with admission AND parenthesized exact original scalar condition
job with block-scalar job-level if: preserve the exact block marker and payload bytes, prepend an admission-and-open-parenthesis payload line, and append one closing-parenthesis payload line
hard_stops: unsupported block-scalar marker or nonstandard block indentation
inline-comment scalar if requiring expression-aware rewriting
any edit outside top-level job-level if insertion/replacement/wrapping
any change to steps, permissions, needs, strategy, runs-on, timeout, env, concurrency, triggers, or action pins
future_patch_proof_obligations: source ci.yml Git blob matches source_ci_blob
top-level job key order is unchanged
every source job exists exactly once in transformed workflow
no new or deleted top-level jobs
every transformed job contains the admission predicate exactly once
every pre-existing scalar if expression is preserved byte-for-byte as a parenthesized conjunct
every pre-existing block marker and block payload are preserved byte-for-byte inside the new admission wrapper
removing only the admission insertion/conjunct/wrapper reconstructs source ci.yml exactly
draft PR event admits zero full-CI jobs by construction
